items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: I’ve played quite a lot of free music with David Friedman and Drori Mondiak, my husband, on drums.

ctx.x: Well Karl Berger surprised me when he said that playing free music is much more precise than not, than non-free he says. “I make my own parameters and it’s not free like people think — play whatever you want.” He was very adamant about the fact that this takes much more concentration than you would think and there are guidelines but they’re self-imposed.

That’s a nice way to say it. There are guidelines and they are self-imposed and people just don’t know what the guideline is going to be at that moment, that they’re shifting guidelines maybe and you don’t agree on them necessarily. Everybody can have their own or you go with the other person’s guideline or — it’s — I’ve played quite a lot of free music with David Friedman and Drori Mondiak, my husband, on drums. David Friedman on vibraphone. And we did a whole CD and we never said one word about the music but…
Well if you — do you remember how many tunes were on that recording you just mentioned of free music?
